"Tolerance and apathy are the last virtues of a dying society"

If they assimilate, I can tolerate "I don't drink alcohol nor eat pork, but obviously can't/won't stop you from doing so". You don't have to become identical to the people in the country you're living in (speak Spanish to your friends, but you need to be able to speak English whenever needed/on forms), but you must be compatible.

It's like Android phones, they're not identical, but everything works on them all (for the most part).

If the statement was "tolerance combined with apathy," then I'd agree with it, but tolerance by itself is not necessarily a bad thing. There's nothing wrong with being tolerant of someone else doing what they want when it doesn't affect you. But when you're tolerant because of apathy, then that allows for the possibility of being tolerant to someone who does want to affect you in a negative way.

The statement doesn't claim it to be a bad thing. It says that both tolerance and apathy are virtues, but when these virtues trump all others, when people no longer stand up for what they believe to be morally right, we lose what other virtues we had and decline.

I should tolerate others having a different opinion than myself, even be apathetic to it, but when others start to trample my own rights I should cease tolerating them or I will meet my demise.
